description: Source code for the Typeahead component of the Twitter typeahead.js library, implementing autocomplete functionality with event handling, UI updates, and user interaction logic.

classes.name: Typeahead
classes.description: Main class implementing the autocomplete input with event handling, activation, deactivation, and suggestion management.

methods.name: _hacks
methods.description: Applies DOM event hacks for IE and menu click prevention.

methods.name: _onDatasetCleared
methods.description: Updates hint when dataset is cleared.

methods.name: _onDatasetRendered
methods.description: Updates hint and manages autoselect after dataset rendering.

methods.name: _onAsyncRequested
methods.description: Triggers event when async request is initiated.

methods.name: _onAsyncCanceled
methods.description: Triggers event when async request is canceled.

methods.name: _onAsyncReceived
methods.description: Triggers event when async data is received.

methods.name: _onEnterKeyed
methods.description: Handles Enter key press for selection.

methods.name: _onTabKeyed
methods.description: Handles Tab key press for autocomplete or selection.

methods.name: _onEscKeyed
methods.description: Handles Escape key to close suggestions.

methods.name: _onUpKeyed
methods.description: Handles Up arrow key to move cursor.

methods.name: _onDownKeyed
methods.description: Handles Down arrow key to move cursor.

methods.name: _onLeftKeyed
methods.description: Handles Left arrow key for RTL languages.

methods.name: _onRightKeyed
methods.description: Handles Right arrow key for LTR languages.

methods.name: _minLengthMet
methods.description: Checks if query length meets minimum.

methods.name: _updateHint
methods.description: Updates input hint based on top suggestion.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the component is enabled.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the component is active.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if suggestion menu is open.
